params.name: start_date
params.description: The start date in UTC (in the format YYYY-MM-DD) you want to query credit obligations for.

params.name: async
params.description: When true the API will return a results_id which can be fetched from the /data/v2/results endpoint when ready. Note: it''s recommended to use the sync flow (async=false) for all requests by adapting the data workflow for connected entities.

items.docs: The Credit Obligations API allows you to fetch a businesses debt obligations, including loan repayments, credit card usage, and balances. You can use this to understand a company's credit exposure, repayment behaviour, and overall financial health.

items.docs: The Non Credit Obligations API allows you to fetch a recurring personal obligations, including labor wage, monthly external and domestic remittances.
